Package view.controller

Class AlbumController

java.lang.Object
view.controller.AlbumController
public class AlbumController extends Object
Controller for the album view. Handles displaying, adding, deleting, tagging, moving, and copying photos, as well as caption editing and album creation from search results.
Author:
Amy Margolina

  • Method Details

    • initData

      public void initData(User user, Album album)
      Initializes the album view with user and album data. Sets up the photo list and UI event handlers.
      Parameters:
      user - the logged-in user
      album - the album to be displayed

    • loadPhotos

      public void loadPhotos()
      Loads the current album's photos into the list view and sets up cell rendering. Displays caption and image thumbnail.

    • addPhoto

      public void addPhoto()
      Opens file chooser to allow the user to import a new photo from disk. Photo path is stored (not copied) and used to track the photo.

    • deletePhoto

      public void deletePhoto()
      Deletes the currently selected photo from the album. If the photo is not in any other album, it is also removed from the user's photo collection.

    • editCaption

      public void editCaption()
      Allows the user to update the caption of the selected photo. Caption updates apply to the photo globally (all albums).

    • addTag

      public void addTag()
      Prompts the user to add a tag to the selected photo. Can choose between predefined types (e.g. person, location) or create a custom tag type. Supports single or multiple tag values depending on type.

    • deleteTag

      public void deleteTag()
      Prompts the user to delete a tag from the selected photo.

    • movePhoto

      public void movePhoto()
      Moves the selected photo to another album (removes from current album).

    • copyPhoto

      public void copyPhoto()
      Copies the selected photo to another album (adds reference, does not duplicate file). Allows a photo to exist in multiple albums.

    • navigateLeft

      public void navigateLeft()
      Navigates to the previous photo in the album with wrap-around.

    • navigateRight

      public void navigateRight()
      Navigates to the next photo in the album with wrap-around.

    • goBack

      public void goBack()
      Navigates back to the user dashboard from the album view.
